fields.Name: Collaboration: Run Space Data
fields.Description: Runs one of the queries or views granted in the space the conversation belongs to (the plan's B20). Name is the granted query or view, as the turn lists them; Values holds the target's own parameters, by name. Anything the grant binds is fixed by the server and never taken from here. Rows come back as JSON.

fields.Name: Name
fields.Description: The granted query or view to run, by the name the turn lists.

fields.Name: Values
fields.Description: The target's own parameters, by name. A parameter the grant binds is refused here: the server fixes it.

fields.Name: Rows
fields.Description: The rows the query or view returned.

fields.Name: RowCount
fields.Description: How many rows came back.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Propose Audience Output
fields.Description: Creates a Team-band draft document and links a Team-private approval Task via TaskLink before any Shared-band publication.

fields.Name: SpaceID
fields.Description: Server-bound space identifier (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: Title
fields.Description: Title for the proposed audience output draft.

fields.Name: Content
fields.Description: Markdown body of the proposed audience output.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: Created approval Task ID.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Promote Draft To Shared
fields.Description: Verifies an approving TaskDecision on a Team-private approval Task and promotes the linked draft to the Shared band under the per-root delivery principal.

fields.Name: SpaceID
fields.Description: Server-bound space identifier (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: DeliveryPrincipalID
fields.Description: Server-bound per-root delivery principal user ID (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: Approval Task ID to approve or reject.

fields.Name: Decision
fields.Description: Approved or Rejected.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Publish Shared Space Update
fields.Description: Publishes an authorized Shared-band update into a space conversation attributed to the configured per-root delivery principal.

fields.Name: SpaceID
fields.Description: Server-bound space identifier (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: DeliveryPrincipalID
fields.Description: Server-bound per-root delivery principal user ID (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: Message
fields.Description: Shared update message content.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Manage Space Document
fields.Description: Creates, reads, updates, lists, or promotes MJ Docs Markdown Documents across Team and Shared bands with strict band isolation.

fields.Name: SpaceID
fields.Description: Server-bound space identifier (hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: Band
fields.Description: Server-bound document band (Team or Shared, hidden from space agents).

fields.Name: Operation
fields.Description: Document operation: create, list, get, update, or promote.

fields.Name: Title
fields.Description: Document title.

fields.Name: Content
fields.Description: Markdown document body.
